definitions.explanation: a person whose profession or vocation is education, especially one who has influence on educational philosophy or practice

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{優|すぐ}れた{教育者|きょういくしゃ}だ。
{教育者|きょういくしゃ}としての{責任|せきにん}を{感|かん}じている。
examples.english: I feel a responsibility as an educator.

examples.japanese: {多|おお}くの{教育者|きょういくしゃ}がこの{問題|もんだい}に{関心|かんしん}を{寄|よ}せている。
examples.english: Many educators are taking an interest in this issue.

examples.japanese: {福沢諭吉|ふくざわゆきち}は{日本|にほん}を{代表|だいひょう}する{教育者|きょういくしゃ}の{一人|ひとり}だ。
examples.english: Fukuzawa Yukichi is one of Japan's most representative educators.

notes:
A formal term for someone devoted to the field of education. Unlike {先生|せんせい}, which refers to a specific teacher, {教育者|きょういくしゃ} describes someone whose identity and life work center on education in a broader sense.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {優|すぐ}れた{教育者|きょういくしゃ}: an outstanding educator
- {教育者|きょういくしゃ}としての{立場|たちば}: one's position as an educator
- {教育者|きょういくしゃ}の{養成|ようせい}: training of educators
- {教育者|きょういくしゃ}の{使命|しめい}: the mission of an educator

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {先生|せんせい}: teacher; refers to a specific person who teaches, used as both a title and a general term
- {教師|きょうし}: teacher (more formal than {先生|せんせい}); focuses on the professional role of teaching in a school
- {指導者|しどうしゃ}: leader or instructor; broader term that includes coaches, mentors, and leaders outside of formal education

FORMS:
{教育|きょういく} (education) + {者|しゃ} (person). The suffix {者|しゃ} marks a person defined by their role or profession.
